name: Let's not stay friends
source:
Friendship is a wonderful thing… unless you are friends with a girl who has no idea you have feelings for her! Inske, a student of magical arts, is troubled by the upcoming outdoors exam, and can't even imagine that someone might want to use the test as an opportunity to get close to her. Meanwhile, the number of applicants for her heart only increases… And while she’s busy figuring out her feelings, she still needs to survive and get a good grade!

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/739980/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
友情是一件美好的事……除非你爱上了一个完全不知道你有这份感情的女孩！魔法艺术学生茵丝克正为即将到来的户外考试烦恼，完全没想到有人会把考试当成接近她的机会。与此同时，追求她的人越来越多……她忙着理清自己的感情，还必须活下来并取得好成绩！

[来源：[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/739980/]Steam[/url]]
